{"open_points":[{"subject":"readiness_endpoint","kind":"contradiction","text":"- readiness_endpoint: [BEHAVIOR] MUST perform the bounded storage initialization check by opening one transaction with begin of the store, which returns a PortalTransaction and creates any missing schemas (storage initialization, not product state: no product row is written), and closing it with exactly one rollback of that transaction and, if the check fails, rolling it back only while it is still open, and only after that check succeeded return only the = models.HealthStatus the imported build_health_status builds, performing no check beyond that storage check (no Registry or other outside service), exposing no path, credential, schema, dependency version, configuration or exception detail, and MUST NOT mutate product state.","other_text":"  guard_action: rollback only while the local flag still marks the transaction open, then re-raise the original exception unchanged
  guard_exception_scope: BaseException
  open_state_tracking: required_local_boolean_flag
  read_path: rollback once immediately after the last read, set the local flag to closed, then evaluate results and raise any domain error","question":"Must readiness perform exactly one rollback invocation even when that rollback raises BaseException, or must the guard leave the flag open until rollback returns and therefore attempt rollback again while handling that exception?"}]}

set_aside.subject: readiness_endpoint
set_aside.text: - readiness_endpoint: [BEHAVIOR] MUST perform the bounded storage initialization check by opening one transaction with begin of the store, which returns a PortalTransaction and creates any missing schemas (storage initialization, not product state: no product row is written), and closing it with exactly one rollback of that transaction and, if the check fails, rolling it back only while it is still open, and only after that check succeeded return only the = models.HealthStatus the imported build_health_status builds, performing no check beyond that storage check (no Registry or other outside service), exposing no path, credential, schema, dependency version, configuration or exception detail, and MUST NOT mutate product state.
set_aside.other_text:
guard_action: rollback only while the local flag still marks the transaction open, then re-raise the original exception unchanged
  guard_exception_scope: BaseException
  open_state_tracking: required_local_boolean_flag
  read_path: rollback once immediately after the last read, set the local flag to closed, then evaluate results and raise any domain error
set_aside.question: Must readiness perform exactly one rollback invocation even when that rollback raises BaseException, or must the guard leave the flag open until rollback returns and therefore attempt rollback again while handling that exception?
